attributes.board_name: Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners

rules.alternatives: Annual CE requirement for PAs is current NCCPA certification (no separate hour count).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Annual CE not required at the first renewal, but the LSBME Laws and Rules course for PAs must be completed before the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Licensees must create a free CE Broker account; non-compliant licensees cannot renew.

topics.who: All PAs: LSBME Laws and Rules course before the first renewal
PAs with a CDS license: Board pre-approved course (CDS prescribing, drug diversion, addiction treatment, chronic pain) before the first renewal; exemption if no CDS prescribed

rules.notes: Renewal yearly in the birth month. PAs practicing emergency medicine: 1-hour sickle cell disease course, then 1-hour refresher at least every 3 years (R.S. 37:1270(A)(8), Act 744 of 2024).
